facts.fact: The Communications Act 2023 (Act 3 of 2023), assented 13 April 2023, sets up a universal access and universal service fund in Part XII (s.99) with contributions (s.100), but the capture holds only the section headings, not the text, and the Act commences on a date the Minister appoints by Gazette notice; no collection or payment is shown.
